scenes.narration: Xe máy lướt qua Sài Gòn oi bức, chàng trai mồ hôi nhễnhại đang chạy gấp đơn hàng cuối ngày.
scenes.narration_en: The motorbike speeds through the humid Saigon; the boy is sweaty and rushing his last order of the day.

scenes.narration_en: Arriving at the customer's door, he gasps as a thick wallet full of cash is found right on his scooter handlebar.

scenes.narration_en: That amount could feed his poor family for a month in the heart of the city.

scenes.narration_en: Guilt drives him to decide he must return immediately to give the property back to its owner.

scenes.narration_en: Placing the wallet on the homeowner's table causes a burst of smile and echoing thanks inside the small room.

scenes.narration_en: The wallet becomes the most precious keepsake cherished forever by all three people together.
